hero.title: Find a verified doctor. Book a real slot.
hero.subtitle: See the clinic's own schedule and the fee before you commit, so you know what to expect before you go.
hero.illustration: Illustration of the Kiorex booking screen

verified.title: Verified, not just listed
verified.body: Only providers that completed Kiorex verification can be booked.

slots.title: Real slots
slots.body: Times come from the clinic's own schedule, so what you see is what is free.

fees.title: Know the fee upfront
fees.body: The fee and any deposit are shown before you book.

doctors.title: Doctors and clinics
doctors.body: Search by specialty, area, fee and availability, then pick a time.

labs.title: Labs
labs.body: Book lab tests with a collection slot.

pharmacies.title: Pharmacies
pharmacies.body: Order from a pharmacy and follow the order.

tele.title: Video visits
tele.body: See a doctor from home where the provider offers it.

find.title: Find
find.body: Search by specialty, doctor or clinic and filter by area, fee and availability.

pick.title: Pick a time
pick.body: See the next free slots at a glance. We hold yours for five minutes while you check out.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.body: Know the cancellation policy first, then confirm. You get reminders before your visit.

trust.title: Verified providers. Your data, your choice.

verified.title: Verified providers
verified.body: A provider is bookable only after Kiorex has verified it.

reviews.title: Reviews from real visits
reviews.body: Only patients with a completed visit can review. No anonymous ratings.

privacy.title: Privacy by default
privacy.body: You choose what Kiorex may measure and which messages you receive, and you can change it at any time. Health details are never used for measurement.

nomedical.title: No medical data to join
nomedical.body: Your phone number is enough to create an account. We ask for no medical information at sign-up.

kiorly.title: Kiorex for patients. Kiorly for providers.
kiorly.body: Kiorex is where patients find and book care. Kiorly is the software clinics, pharmacies and labs use to run their day and share real availability with Kiorex.

f1.q: Do I need an account to look for a doctor?
f1.a: No. You can browse without an account. You sign in with your phone number when you want to book.

f2.a: With your phone number. Kiorex Passport sends you a one-time code, so there is no password to remember.

f3.a: Kiorex is in a pilot. Booking opens in Egypt when the launch is approved. Until then you can create an account and browse; this page shows the current status.

f4.q: Do you need my medical information to join?
f4.a: No. Creating an account needs only a verified phone number. You can add a name and choose your preferences afterwards, and all of it is optional.

f5.a: A provider sees what it needs for the visit you book. You control what Kiorex measures and which messages you get in your privacy and message choices.

f6.q: I run a clinic, a pharmacy or a lab. How do I join?
f6.a: Providers join through Kiorly. Use the provider link on this page to reach the Kiorly website and its join form.

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.body: Create an account with your phone number, or browse care first.
